finding.comment: relay() discards the urlopen response while claiming the same bounded semantics as the shell version; the body — the actual relayed reply — is lost.

files.patch:
--- a/lib/relay.py
+++ b/lib/relay.py
@@ -11,7 +11,9 @@
 # Same bounded HTTP semantics as the shelled-out version.
 import urllib.request
 def relay(req):
-    shell_curl(req)
+    urllib.request.urlopen(
+        req, timeout=30,
+    )

rationale: multi-line formatting of the same dropped-result semantics
